title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 075
review_goal: Differentiate pen, pencil, and photo album variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Diagonal pen body with one pointed tip at lower left and one rounded cap above
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a full pen body angled across the icon instead of a nib frame.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the pencil variants when the tip shape and cap details should match a pencil body.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a complete pen body leaning diagonally with a rounded cap at the top.

items.depicts_observation: Diagonal pencil body with one pointed tip at lower left and one eraser cap above
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a simple pencil body angled diagonally across the icon.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the underline or squiggle pencil variants when a second mark should appear below.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps the diagonal pencil body alone without any extra mark below it.

items.depicts_observation: Diagonal pencil body above one short underline bar at the lower right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a pencil paired with a short underline bar beneath it.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the plain pencil when no extra line should appear under the body.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot adds one short horizontal bar below the diagonal pencil body.

items.depicts_observation: Diagonal pencil body above one wavy line mark at the lower right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a pencil paired with a short wavy line under the tip.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the underline pencil when the lower mark should stay straight and flat.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot swaps the underline bar for a wavy squiggle below the diagonal pencil.

items.depicts_observation: Stacked photo frame with one back sheet behind one mountain picture panel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a photo panel with a second sheet stacked behind it.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the bound album cover when a top binding strip should cap the frame.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot places one extra back sheet behind the front mountain picture frame.
